text: 钟窖底下还留着一枚钟舌。你若下去，替我取回来。
voice: Male, elderly, a weary bellkeeper, deep gravelly low voice, slow and calm, slightly raspy, speaking Mandarin Chinese

text: 它本该在黄昏敲响，让走失的人认得回家的路。
ref_text: 钟窖底下还留着一枚钟舌。你若下去，替我取回来。

text: 钟声曾从这里出发，穿过雾，落回每个走失的人耳边。
voice: Female, ethereal memory echo, soft airy voice, gentle reverb, slow and distant, speaking Mandarin Chinese
